title: Motion Verbs 10: The Rest of the Family (run, fly, carry)
titleRussian: Глаголы движения 10: Остальные пары (бежать, лететь, нести)
description: The same one-way / round-trip split you drilled on идти/ходить and ехать/ездить runs through the rest of the family: бежать/бегать, лететь/летать, плыть/плавать, plus the transitive carrying verbs нести, вести, везти.
descriptionRussian: Тот же контраст «однонаправленный / туда-обратно», который вы отрабатывали на парах идти/ходить и ехать/ездить, действует и в остальной семье: бежать/бегать, лететь/летать, плыть/плавать, а также в переходных глаголах нести, вести, везти.
intro: The pattern you learned for walking and driving covers the whole family. Running, flying and swimming split exactly the same way, and so do three verbs for carrying, which add a direct object without changing anything about the choice. The past tense of the carrying verbs is irregular and worth drilling separately, but the decision you make is one you already know.
rules: Every motion pair has a one-way member (single trip, in progress, with a destination) and a round-trip member (habit, ability, there-and-back): бежать/бегать, лететь/летать, плыть/плавать. The cues сейчас, часто, по выходным choose the member exactly as they did for идти/ходить.
The one-way members are short and irregular in the present: бегу/бежишь/бегут, лечу/летишь/летят, плыву/плывёшь/плывут. The round-trip members are regular -ать verbs: бегаю, летаю, плаваю.

The transitive carriers take a direct object in the accusative: нести (carry by hand), вести (lead / take a person), везти (convey by vehicle). Their round-trip partners are носить, водить, возить; носить also means to wear.
The carrying object does not change the choice. The cue still decides: нести сумку сейчас (one trip in progress) vs носить очки (habitual / characteristic).
The past of the -сти carriers is irregular: нёс / несла / несли; вёл / вела / вели; вёз / везла / везли. Masculine has stressed -ё-; feminine and plural use -е- with stress on the ending.
examples: Маша бежит на автобус! (Masha is running for the bus!) Бежать: one-way, in progress, on foot.
Я бегаю в парке по утрам. (I run in the park in the mornings.) Бегать: habit.
Самолёт летит в Москву. (The plane is flying to Moscow.) Лететь: one-way trip in progress.
Птицы летают над озером. (Birds are flying around above the lake.) Летать: round-trip / general motion.
Лодка плывёт к острову. (The boat is sailing toward the island.) Плыть: one specific voyage.
Рыбы плавают в реке. (Fish swim in the river.) Плавать: general ability / habit.
Антон несёт сумку домой. (Anton is carrying a bag home.) Нести: one-way, in progress, transitive.
Маша носит очки. (Masha wears glasses.) Носить: habitual / characteristic.
Учитель ведёт детей в музей. (The teacher is taking the children to the museum.) Вести: one-way trip in progress.
Папа возит детей в школу каждое утро. (Dad drives the kids to school every morning.) Возить: habitual, transitive.

tables.title: Irregular Past Tense of the -сти Carriers

sentenceBuilding.translation: I am running for the bus.
sentenceBuilding.hint: One trip in progress, on foot, toward a destination right now. Use the one-way member of бежать/бегать, 1sg.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton is carrying a bag home.
sentenceBuilding.hint: A single carrying trip in progress with a direct object. Use the one-way carrier нести, 3sg.

sentenceBuilding.translation: I love to swim in the lake.
sentenceBuilding.hint: General ability, not one specific voyage. After люблю, use the round-trip infinitive of плыть/плавать.

items.prompt: Я каждое утро _____ в парке полчаса.
items.promptEnglish: Every morning I run in the park for half an hour.
items.hint: 'Каждое утро' is a habit cue. Which member of the pair does that pull?
items.explanation: 'Каждое утро ...Полчаса' is the canonical habit / round-trip frame. The round-trip member of the бежать/бегать pair is бегать (1sg: бегаю). Бегу would describe a single trip in progress right now; побежал marks the moment of setting off (perfective past); побегу is perfective future.

items.promptEnglish: The plane is flying over the Atlantic right now.
items.hint: 'Сейчас ... над' frames a single in-progress trip. Which member of the лететь/летать pair?
items.explanation: 'Сейчас ...Над Атлантикой' is a single-trip-in-progress frame: the plane is mid-flight on one specific journey. The one-way member of the pair is лететь (3sg: летит). Летает would mean flies around habitually or in general; полетел marks the moment of takeoff; прилетел means arrived.

items.prompt: Антон _____ тяжёлую сумку домой и устал.
items.promptEnglish: Anton was carrying a heavy bag home and got tired.
items.hint: 'Домой и устал' frames a single in-progress trip. Which past form?
items.explanation: 'Тяжёлую сумку домой и устал' is the canonical in-progress frame: the carrying is happening at the moment described, in one direction, until he got tired. The one-way past of нести (masc) is нёс. Носил would describe a habit or a round-trip; понёс marks the moment of starting to carry; принёс means brought (arrival).

items.hint: 'Wears' is a characteristic, not a single carrying trip. Which member of the pair carries that meaning?
items.explanation: Носить has a second meaning: to wear (clothes, glasses, jewelry). This is the round-trip / habitual member of the pair, generalized to characteristic possession. Несёт would mean is carrying right now, which is not the wearing reading. Понесла and принесла are perfective past carrying forms, neither of which fits a standing characteristic.

items.prompt: Папа _____ детей в школу каждое утро на машине.
items.promptEnglish: Dad drives the kids to school every morning.
items.hint: 'Каждое утро' is a habit cue, and the children are conveyed by car. Which form?
items.explanation: 'Каждое утро на машине' is the canonical habit / round-trip frame with a transport-conveying transitive verb. The round-trip member of the везти/возить pair is возить (3sg: возит). Везёт would describe a single trip in progress; повёз marks the moment of setting off; привёз means arrived with the kids.

items.promptEnglish: The boat is sailing toward the island right now.
items.hint: 'К острову прямо сейчас' is one voyage in progress toward one destination. Which member of плыть/плавать?
items.explanation: 'К острову прямо сейчас' frames a single voyage in progress toward one destination: the one-way member плыть (3sg: плывёт). Плавает would mean sails or swims around habitually or as a general ability; поплыла marks setting off (perfective past); приплыла means arrived. This mirrors идти/ходить on the water.

items.promptEnglish: Birds are flying around above the lake all day.
items.hint: 'Весь день ... над озером' is a round-trip / general-motion frame, not a single one-way trip.
items.explanation: 'Весь день ...Над озером' frames continuous back-and-forth motion: the birds are flying around, not toward one specific destination. The round-trip member is летать (3pl: летают). Летят would describe a flock heading in one direction at one moment; полетели means took off; прилетели means arrived.

items.promptEnglish: Right now the teacher is taking the children to the museum.
items.hint: 'Сейчас ... в музей' frames a single leading-trip in progress toward one destination. Which carrier?
items.explanation: 'Сейчас ...В музей' frames a single leading-trip in progress toward one destination: the one-way carrier вести (3sg: ведёт). Водит would mean habitual taking or drives a car (водит машину); повела marks the moment of setting off with them; привела means brought (arrived with them). The object детей rides along; the pair logic is the same as идти/ходить.

items.prompt: Маша _____ книги в библиотеку и забыла одну дома.
items.promptEnglish: Masha was carrying the books to the library and forgot one at home.
items.hint: 'В библиотеку и забыла одну дома' frames the carrying as a single in-progress trip during which she noticed.
items.explanation: The clause 'и забыла одну дома' anchors the carrying as a single one-way trip in progress: while she was on her way with the books, she realized one was missing. The one-way past of нести (fem) is несла. Носила would mean habitual carrying or a round-trip; понесла marks the moment of setting off; принесла means brought (arrived with them).

items.promptEnglish: Every morning I run in the park.
items.hint: A habit inside a place, no single destination.
items.explanation: The habit-and-around reading takes the round-trip бегать with a location: бегаю в парке. Бегу в парк would be one run toward the park right now; побежал marks a takeoff moment.

items.promptEnglish: The plane is flying to Moscow now.
items.hint: One flight in progress toward one destination.
items.explanation: 'Сейчас' plus one destination is a single trip: the one-way лететь, летит в Москву. Летает would mean flies around or regularly; летал and прилетал are past forms.

items.promptEnglish: Dad drives the kids to school every morning.
items.hint: A daily carrying routine: which carrier verb?
items.explanation: The habit takes the round-trip carrier возить: возит детей. Везёт would be this one trip in progress; повёз marks a departure; привёз one completed delivery.

items.promptEnglish: Anton is carrying a heavy box home right now.
items.hint: One carrying trip in progress with a direct object.
items.explanation: 'Сейчас ... домой' is one carrying trip: the one-way нести, несёт. Носит would be habitual carrying around; приносил a repeated past delivery.

blanks: Антон сейчас _____ тяжёлый чемодан на вокзал. (Anton is carrying a heavy suitcase to the station right now.)
Дети _____ через двор, потому что опаздывают. (The kids are running across the yard right now because they are late.)
Рыбы _____ в этой реке круглый год. (Fish swim in this river all year round.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Three different cues choose the member: (1) 'сейчас ...На вокзал' is one carrying trip in progress, so нести 3sg несёт; (2) 'через двор ...Опаздывают' is one urgent run in progress, so бежать 3pl бегут; (3) 'круглый год' is a general habit / ability, so плавать 3pl плавают.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton is carrying the books to the library right now.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Сейчас ...В библиотеку' is the canonical one-way in-progress frame: one trip, one direction, currently underway. The one-way member of the carrying pair is нести (3sg: несёт). Носит would mean habitual / characteristic carrying or, in the wear sense, wears. Neither matches the сейчас frame.

minimalPairs.context: Каждое лето мы _____ в этом озере.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Every summer we swim in this lake.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Каждое лето ...В этом озере' is a habit / general-ability frame with no single destination. The round-trip member is плавать (1pl: плаваем). Плывём would mean we are sailing or swimming toward one place on one specific occasion, which clashes with the recurring summer habit.

errorCorrection.sentence: Каждое утро Антон бежит в парке.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Every morning Anton runs in the park.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Каждое утро ... в парке' is a habit frame with back-and-forth, non-specific motion (running inside a park, not from A to B). The round-trip / habit member of the pair is бегать: бегает. Бежит means one run toward one place right now.

errorCorrection.sentence: Птица летит над озером весь день.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: A bird flies around above the lake all day.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Весь день ... над озером' frames continuous back-and-forth motion: flying around, not toward one destination. The round-trip member of the pair is летать: летает. Летит would describe a flight toward one place; прилетела would be an arrival.

errorCorrection.sentence: Смотри, Антон носит тяжёлую сумку к машине.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Look, Anton is carrying a heavy bag to the car right now.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Смотри ... к машине' frames one carrying-trip in progress toward one destination: the one-way member нести (3sg: несёт). Носит would mean habitual carrying (carries regularly) or carrying around with no direction. Принёс would be the completed delivery.

errorCorrection.sentence: Смотри, Антон носит большую коробку к машине.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Look, Anton is carrying a big box to the car.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Смотри ...К машине' frames a single carrying trip in progress, in one direction, right now: the one-way member нести (3sg: несёт). Носит would mean habitual or characteristic carrying, or wears (носит очки), neither of which fits look, [right now] to the car. Понёс marks the moment of starting to carry; принёс means brought (arrival). The transitive object коробку does not change the pair logic.

errorCorrection.sentence: Сейчас папа возит детей в школу на машине.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Right now dad is driving the kids to school.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Сейчас ... в школу' frames a single conveying-trip in progress toward one destination: the one-way member везти (3sg: везёт). Возит would mean the regular routine (drives them every day), not this one trip happening now.

errorCorrection.sentence: Бабушка каждое утро ведёт внука в детский сад.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Grandma takes her grandson to kindergarten every morning.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Каждое утро' is a habit frame: a there-and-back routine, not one specific trip. The round-trip leader is водить (3sg: водит). Ведёт would mean is leading him right now on one trip. Привела would be one completed delivery.

patternRecognition.question: What is the pair structure operating here?
options: One-way transitive carrying (нести): one trip in progress with a direct object.
Round-trip transitive carrying (носить): habitual or characteristic.
Round-trip member of the foot pair (ходить).
Round-trip member of the flying pair (летать).
patternRecognition.answer: One-way transitive carrying (нести): one trip in progress with a direct object.
patternRecognition.explanation: Сумку is the direct object (accusative); на почту names a single destination on a single trip. The verb is the one-way carrying member, нести (1sg: несу). The transitive layer adds the object; the pair logic is unchanged from идти/ходить.

patternRecognition.sentence: Антон возит туристов по городу на маршрутке.
patternRecognition.question: Why is the round-trip member of the pair correct here?
options: Because the verb is transitive and transitive motion verbs only have round-trip forms.
Because туристов is in the accusative.
Because the verb describes a recurring conveying activity (his job, his routine), not a single one-way trip.
Because на маршрутке is in the prepositional case.
patternRecognition.answer: Because the verb describes a recurring conveying activity (his job, his routine), not a single one-way trip.
patternRecognition.explanation: The frame по городу на маршрутке (around the city by minibus) is non-directional, generic, habitual: Anton does this for a living. The round-trip member of везти/возить is возить (3sg: возит). The transitive layer is real but it does not force the round-trip choice; the choice is forced by the habit / back-and-forth cue family.

patternRecognition.question: Why is the one-way member of бежать/бегать correct here?
options: Because бежать is the only form that exists.
Because сейчас plus a single destination (к остановке) marks one trip in progress.
Because к остановке is in the genitive case.
patternRecognition.answer: Because сейчас plus a single destination (к остановке) marks one trip in progress.
patternRecognition.explanation: Сейчас pins the action to this moment, and к остановке names one destination on one trip. That is the one-way frame, so the one-way member бежать (3sg: бежит) is correct. Бегает would mean runs around habitually or as exercise, which the сейчас + destination cue rules out.

reviewVocab.definition: to run: бежать is the one-way member (one trip in progress, бегу/бежишь/бегут), бегать is the round-trip / habit member (regular: бегаю).
reviewVocab.example: Маша бежит на автобус. Я бегаю в парке по утрам.

reviewVocab.definition: to fly and to swim/sail: лететь and плыть are the one-way members (летит, плывёт), летать and плавать are the round-trip / habit members (летают, плавают).
reviewVocab.example: Самолёт летит в Москву. Рыбы плавают в реке.

reviewVocab.definition: the transitive one-way carriers, taking a direct object: нести (carry by hand), вести (lead / take a person), везти (convey by vehicle). Irregular past: нёс/несла, вёл/вела, вёз/везла. Round-trip partners: носить, водить, возить.
reviewVocab.example: Антон несёт сумку домой. Учитель ведёт детей в музей. Папа возит детей в школу.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each sentence by whether the verb is the one-way member (single trip in progress) or the round-trip member (habit / there-and-back).

items.word: Птицы летают над озером весь день.
Я бегаю в парке по утрам.
Папа возит детей в школу каждое утро.
